Car crash on Purvanchal Expressway kills 3, injures 3

Three young cricketers were killed and three others were injured when their car collided with a truck on the Purvanchal Expressway. The group was returning to Deoria from a cricket match in Lucknow. The injured were taken to Medical College for treatment, and police have launched an investigation into the incident.
